steps: Turn on hazard lights immediately
Move as far left off the road as possible
Place reflective triangle 50m behind vehicle
Call NHAI helpline: 1033
Stay in vehicle with doors locked if unsafe outside
Call 108 ambulance immediately — do not delay
Do NOT move injured person unless fire risk
Turn on hazard lights and place warning triangle
Keep victim warm, conscious — talk to them
Clear traffic from around the scene safely
Move everyone at least 100 metres away immediately
Call 101 (Fire) or 112 (Unified)
Do NOT open the bonnet if smoke is from engine
Never return to a burning vehicle for any reason
Warn other road users to keep distance
Drive to the nearest police station or petrol pump
Call 100 (Police) or 1091 (Women Helpline) immediately
Share your live location with a trusted contact
Stay in a lit, populated area — do not stop remotely
Call 108 ambulance immediately
Do not give food or water
Keep person still and comfortable
Talk to them — hearing is the last sense lost
Follow dispatcher instructions until ambulance arrives
Turn on hazard lights if you are in a vehicle
Move to a safe location away from traffic
Call 112 — unified emergency works everywhere in India
Share your location with someone you trust
